ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited (AIIL) announced the successful implementation of the resolution plan for Wind World (India) Limited (WWIL) by its consortium with Inox Neo Energies Limited. The Implementation and Monitoring Committee (IMC) declared October 8, 2026, as the formal Implementation Date, signifying the completion of the consortium's obligations. This marks a positive milestone for AIIL, successfully finalizing a key acquisition previously under a resolution process, with no immediate red flags identified in this specific disclosure.
